title: Correlation of Two Lists
description:
Read two lines of space-separated numbers (the same length). Print the correlation coefficient between them, rounded to 2 decimals, using `np.corrcoef`.

Example: `1 2 3 4` and `2 4 6 8` print `1.0`.
starter_code:
import numpy as np

xs = [float(v) for v in input().split()]
ys = [float(v) for v in input().split()]
# Print the correlation
solution_code:
import numpy as np

xs = [float(v) for v in input().split()]
ys = [float(v) for v in input().split()]
print(round(float(np.corrcoef(xs, ys)[0, 1]), 2))
